I wanted to share with you one of the lesser known developers in the PCgaming world.

BeamNG is a soft body physics simulator that was initially released in August 2013 in early access. They recently released an update on March 11th, 2016 0.5.3. This was a pretty big update as it introduced an entirely new feature to the game-thermals.

While this patch was great, it did create a few bugs and performance issues. What did BeamNG do? They released a new patch on March 15th 0.5.3.1. This was released to fix a few issues from the previous patch and ensure all the new features were working properly by making tweaks to a few vehicles in the game.

Unfortunately, this patch created its own problems-two maps in the game were not rendering properly. Not 24 hours later, BeamNG put out a fix for this in the form of 0.5.3.2 fixing these issues. I was blown away and wanted to share to all of you how great these developers are.

You can find their full devblog here. This is not the first time they have done this, they consistently follow up their updates with quick patches to fix major issues. They should stand as a role model to other developers to do the same.
